gcodes.ACEK_ADAPTER_STATUS: Report what the ace2k U1 adapter hooked
gcodes.ACEK_BG_MOVE: Move parked HEAD's extruder DISTANCE mm at VELOCITY mm/s, outside a print (bench)
gcodes.ACEK_BG_STATUS: Report the background swap of each head
gcodes.ACEK_BG_STOP: Stop HEAD's background swap at its next step, or drop the state it kept
gcodes.ACEK_BG_SWAP: Swap parked HEAD to LANE in its dock, outside a print (bench); its T loads it
gcodes.ACEK_EJECT: Take LANE's filament (of UNIT, with several units) out of its bay, unloading its head on the U1 first when the head holds it; WAIT=0 returns at once
gcodes.ACEK_FREE_CHECK: Run a swap's free check on LANE (of UNIT) alone: roll it back up to LENGTH at SPEED, watching its plunger; says free or held
gcodes.ACEK_HEAD_PREPARE: Before Load into head N: push LANE (of UNIT) to its head's sensor to read its tag when its material is not set; refused when it stays unset
gcodes.ACEK_HEAD_PROBE: Run a print start's probe of shared HEAD alone (its sensor set, the head cold); with the sensor empty, push LANE (of UNIT) to it as a swap does
gcodes.ACEK_HEAD_SPOOL: Set the filament of the head that LANE (of UNIT) is in from the lane's spool, as a swap does: its tag, else its ACEK_SPOOL record
gcodes.ACEK_PLAN: Read FILE's tools and suggest a lane for each
gcodes.ACEK_PLAN_SET: Keep FILE's tool -> lane choice (T0=a:1 T1=b:3 ...) for its print
gcodes.ACEK_SPLITTER_MEASURE: Measure how far a lane of shared HEAD rolls back to leave its splitter, and stage headN_splitter_mm for SAVE_CONFIG
gcodes.ACEK_SPOOL: Set the spool of LANE (of UNIT): TYPE=, COLOR=rrggbb, VENDOR=
gcodes.ACEK_TAG_FORGET: Forget the tag read on a lane, without reading it again until its spool leaves the bay

pause_reasons.load_failure: ace2k_u1: lane 1 push to e0: no_filament
pause_reasons.swap_failure: ace2k_u1: head 1: a:1 → a:2 (T2) failed at free: a:1 is still held by head 1 after a second unload

eject_say.head_now_empty: ace2k_u1: lane {n} eject: head now empty — unloading
eject_say.head_empty: ace2k_u1: lane {n} eject: head empty — unloading
eject_say.parked: ace2k_u1: lane {n} eject: parked outside its head — unloading
eject_say.filament_free: ace2k_u1: lane {n} eject: filament free (plunger at rest) — unloading
eject_say.held: ace2k_u1: lane {n} eject: held by the head ({why}) — unloading the head on the U1
eject_say.net: ace2k_u1: lane {n} eject: the unload met the head's gear {mm:.1f} mm in — the lane cleared, held by the head after all — unloading the head on the U1
eject_say.plunger_not_at_rest: ace2k_u1: lane {n} eject: plunger not at rest after the feed back — going on, the U1's unload settles it
eject_say.no_decision: ace2k_u1: lane {n} eject: no decision after {s:g} s — ACEK_EJECT returns, the eject runs on

set: ace2k_u1: the unit's firmware has no wait; flash v0.13.0 or later — a lone head's new filament is gripped
ace2k_u1: lane 1 grip not set — the link is down
cleared: ace2k_u1: lane 1 grip not cleared — the link is down
